description: ImapInboxSourceComponent — fetch emails from an IMAP server.

outputs.description: pandas DataFrame with one row per vendor record. Chain a downstream sink component (dataframe_to_snowflake / _to_bigquery / _to_duckdb / ...) to persist.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var containing the mailbox username (typically the email address).

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var containing the password (for Gmail use an app password).

mailbox.label: Mailbox
mailbox.description: IMAP folder to read from. Common: INBOX, '[Gmail]/All Mail', Archive.

search_criteria.label: Search Criteria
search_criteria.description: IMAP search expression. Examples: 'UNSEEN', 'ALL', '(FROM "alerts@")', 'SINCE 01-Jan-2025', 'SUBJECT "invoice"'. IMAP dates are dd-Mon-yyyy, so a partitioned run also fills {partition_imap_since} (the window's first day) and {partition_imap_before} (the first day after it), e.g. 'SINCE {partition_imap_since} BEFORE {partition_imap_before}'.

max_messages.label: Max Messages
max_messages.description: Cap on how many messages to fetch in a single run.

mark_read.label: Mark Read
mark_read.description: After fetching, set the \Seen flag on each message so the next UNSEEN run skips them. Set False to leave unread (useful for testing).

include_body_html.label: Include Body Html
include_body_html.description: Emit the raw HTML body too (in addition to text). Off by default — adds bulk.

fallback_html_to_text.label: Fallback Html To Text
fallback_html_to_text.description: If a message has only HTML body, derive a text body by stripping tags.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a markdown preview of the fetched messages in the materialization metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Max rows to include in the preview when include_preview_metadata is True.

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

name: Imap Inbox Source
